manager_requirement: California requires every food facility that prepares or serves unpackaged, perishable food to have at least one owner or employee who has passed an accredited food safety manager exam, such as ServSafe Manager. The certificate is valid for 5 years. New or newly purchased businesses have 60 days to comply.
manager_requirement_es: California exige que cada establecimiento que prepara o sirve comida perecedera sin empaquetar tenga al menos un dueño o empleado que haya aprobado un examen acreditado de gerente en seguridad alimentaria, como ServSafe Manager. El certificado es válido por 5 años. Los negocios nuevos o recién comprados tienen 60 días para cumplir.
food_handler_requirement: Most other food employees need a California Food Handler Card within 30 days of hire, valid for 3 years, and the employer pays for the training. Employees who hold a valid ServSafe Manager certificate don't need a separate food handler card. Riverside, San Bernardino, and San Diego counties run their own local programs instead.
food_handler_requirement_es: La mayoría de los demás empleados de comida necesitan la California Food Handler Card dentro de los 30 días de ser contratados, válida por 3 años, y el empleador paga la capacitación. Los empleados con un certificado ServSafe Manager vigente no necesitan una tarjeta de manipulador aparte. Los condados de Riverside, San Bernardino y San Diego tienen sus propios programas locales.
state_faq: Does California accept ServSafe?::Yes. ServSafe Manager is an accredited food protection manager exam accepted in California.||Do all my employees need ServSafe Manager?::No. One certified manager is required. Most other food workers need the California Food Handler Card instead.
state_faq_es: ¿California acepta ServSafe?::Sí. ServSafe Manager es un examen acreditado para gerentes de protección de alimentos aceptado en California.||¿Todos mis empleados necesitan ServSafe Manager?::No. Se requiere un gerente certificado. La mayoría de los demás trabajadores necesitan la California Food Handler Card.
rules_source: Verified 10/17/2026: CA H&S Code 113947.1 (manager cert, 5-yr recert, 60 days); CA Food Handler Card law 113948 (30 days, 3 yrs, manager cert exempt, Riverside/San Bernardino/San Diego local programs); LA County DPH certified food handler page (employer pays).

manager_requirement: Indiana requires most food establishments to have at least one certified food handler, meaning a manager who has passed an accredited exam such as ServSafe Manager. The certificate is valid for 5 years.
manager_requirement_es: Indiana exige que la mayoría de los establecimientos de comida tengan al menos un manipulador de alimentos certificado, es decir, un gerente que haya aprobado un examen acreditado como ServSafe Manager. El certificado es válido por 5 años.
food_handler_requirement: Indiana does not require a statewide food handler card for other employees.
food_handler_requirement_es: Indiana no exige una tarjeta estatal de manipulador de alimentos para los demás empleados.
state_faq: Does Indiana accept ServSafe?::Yes. Indiana calls it a Certified Food Handler. The ServSafe Manager exam is an accredited exam that meets the requirement.||How long is an Indiana food manager certificate good for?::Indiana requires you to recertify within 5 years of your most recent certificate, which matches the 5-year ServSafe Manager certificate.||Is there a training requirement in Indiana?::No. Indiana's rule is exam-based. You can study any way you like, then pass an accredited exam such as ServSafe Manager.
rules_source: Verified 10/19/2026: Indiana Department of Health Certified Food Handler rule 410 IAC 7-22 / IC 16-42-5.2 (one certified food handler per establishment, renew within 5 years, locals may not require food handler cards); Marion County Public Health confirms the same rule.

manager_requirement: Georgia requires every food service establishment to have at least one Certified Food Safety Manager (CFSM) who has passed an accredited exam such as ServSafe Manager. New establishments, new owners and places whose certified manager leaves have 60 days to comply. The certificate is renewed on the exam provider's schedule, every 5 years for ServSafe Manager.
food_handler_requirement: Georgia does not require a statewide food handler card. The Certified Food Safety Manager is responsible for training the rest of the staff in food safety.
health_dept_name: Georgia Department of Public Health — Environmental Health
state_faq: Does Georgia accept ServSafe?::Yes. Georgia calls it a Certified Food Safety Manager (CFSM). The ServSafe Manager exam is an accredited exam that meets Georgia's requirement.||How long does a new Georgia restaurant have to get a certified manager?::60 days from when the food service permit is issued. The same 60 days applies after a change of ownership or when the certified manager leaves.
rules_source: Verified 11/4/2026: Ga. Comp. R. & Regs. 511-6-1-.03(3) (CFSM required, accredited exam, 60 days for new permit / change of owner / CFSM leaving, renewal per exam provider; no statewide food handler card, CFSM trains staff).

manager_requirement: Florida requires every manager responsible for storing, preparing, displaying or serving food to pass an accredited food protection manager exam such as ServSafe Manager within 30 days of being hired. When four or more employees are working with food at one time, a certified manager must be on site. The certificate is valid for 5 years.
food_handler_requirement: Other food employees need Florida-approved food handler training (DBPR-approved for restaurants) soon after they're hired. That's a separate, shorter course from the manager certification.
health_dept_name: Florida DBPR — Division of Hotels and Restaurants
state_faq: Does Florida accept ServSafe?::Yes. ServSafe Manager is an accredited food protection manager exam accepted by the Florida DBPR Division of Hotels and Restaurants.||How long do I have to get certified in Florida?::Florida gives a new manager 30 days after being hired to pass an approved exam such as ServSafe Manager.||Does a certified manager have to be there all the time?::When four or more employees are working with food at the same time, Florida requires a certified manager on site.
rules_source: Verified 11/5/2026: Fla. Stat. 509.039 (all managers certified, 30 days after employment); Fla. Admin. Code 61C-4.023 (certified manager present when 4+ employees engaged in food prep/service, certificate valid 5 years, approved employee training); DBPR Hotels & Restaurants food manager page.

manager_requirement: North Carolina requires the person in charge of a food establishment to be a Certified Food Protection Manager who has passed an accredited exam such as ServSafe Manager, with a certified manager on duty during all hours of operation. The ServSafe Manager certificate is valid for 5 years.
food_handler_requirement: North Carolina does not require a statewide food handler card for other food employees.
health_dept_name: NC DHHS — Environmental Health Section, Food Protection
state_faq: Does North Carolina accept ServSafe?::Yes. ServSafe Manager is an accredited Certified Food Protection Manager exam that meets North Carolina's requirement.||Does a certified manager have to be there every shift?::Yes. North Carolina requires the person in charge to be a Certified Food Protection Manager during all hours of operation, so most restaurants certify more than one manager.
rules_source: Verified 11/5/2026: NC Food Code (15A NCAC 18A .2600, FDA Food Code 2-102.11/2-102.12 as amended) — PIC must be a CFPM during all hours of operation; NC DHHS CFPM implementation notice; no statewide food handler card.

manager_requirement: Alabama requires most food establishments (Priority Category 3 and 4, which covers most restaurants) to have a person in charge with a valid certification from an accredited program such as ServSafe Manager, and a certified person in charge must be present during all hours of operation. The ServSafe Manager certificate is valid for 5 years.
food_handler_requirement: Alabama does not require a statewide food handler card for other food employees.
health_dept_name: Alabama Department of Public Health — Food, Milk and Lodging
state_faq: Does Alabama accept ServSafe?::Yes. ServSafe Manager is an accredited food protection manager certification that meets Alabama's requirement.||Does a certified manager have to be there every shift?::Yes, at most restaurants. Since January 1, 2020, Alabama requires a certified person in charge to be present during all hours of operation, so most restaurants certify more than one manager.
rules_source: Verified 11/8/2026: Ala. Admin. Code r. 420-3-22-.02 (Priority Category 3 and 4 establishments: permit holder or designee holds valid accredited certification; certified person in charge present during all hours of operation from 1/1/2020; Category 1-2 and temporary establishments exempt). Jefferson County DOH offers the ServSafe exam locally.

manager_requirement: Texas requires at least one employee with supervisory and management responsibility at a food establishment to be a Certified Food Manager who has passed an approved exam such as ServSafe Manager. Some cities, and counties of 4 million or more people, can require a certified manager on site at all times. The ServSafe Manager certificate is valid for 5 years.
food_handler_requirement: All other food employees must complete an accredited food handler course within 30 days of being hired. Certified Food Managers don't need a separate food handler card.
state_faq: Does Texas accept ServSafe?::Yes. ServSafe Manager is an ANSI-accredited food manager exam accepted in Texas, including when taken online.||Do my other employees need a food handler card?::Yes. Texas requires every food employee to complete an accredited food handler course within 30 days of hire. Certified Food Managers are exempt.||Does my city have extra rules?::Some Texas cities, and counties of 4 million or more people, can require a certified manager on site at all times. Check with your local health department.
rules_source: Verified 11/8/2026: 25 TAC 228.31 (TFER) — at least one employee with supervisory/management responsibility must be a CFM; cities and counties of 4M+ may require CFM on site at all times; food handlers trained within 30 days of employment, CFMs exempt (DSHS food manager and food handler FAQs); internet-proctored exams valid in Texas.

manager_requirement: South Carolina requires at least one employee with the authority to direct and control food preparation and service to be a certified food protection manager, certified through an ANSI-accredited program such as ServSafe Manager. The ServSafe Manager certificate is valid for 5 years.
food_handler_requirement: South Carolina's rule is built around the certified manager. Check with the SC Department of Agriculture about training for other food employees.
health_dept_name: SC Department of Agriculture — Retail Food Safety
state_faq: Does South Carolina accept ServSafe?::Yes. ServSafe Manager is an ANSI-accredited food protection manager exam that meets South Carolina's requirement.||Who inspects restaurants in South Carolina?::The SC Department of Agriculture runs the retail food safety inspection program, which moved there from the former DHEC.
rules_source: Verified 11/8/2026: SCDA Regulation 61-25 (2-102.12/2-102.20) — at least one employee with authority to direct and control food prep and service must be a CFPM certified by an ANSI/CFP-accredited program; retail food inspection moved from DHEC to SCDA (SCDA retail food FAQ).

manager_requirement: Mississippi requires food establishments to have a certified food protection manager, and the certificate must be held by someone who works in the facility. ServSafe Manager is accepted, and the exam can be taken online with a remote proctor. The ServSafe Manager certificate is valid for 5 years.
food_handler_requirement: Mississippi's rule is built around the certified manager. Check with the Mississippi State Department of Health about training for other food employees.
health_dept_name: Mississippi State Department of Health — Food Protection
state_faq: Does Mississippi accept ServSafe?::Yes. ServSafe Manager is accepted, and the exam can be proctored online.||Can the certified manager work somewhere else?::No. Mississippi requires the certificate to be held by someone who works in the facility.
rules_source: Verified 11/8/2026: MSU Extension publication P4135 (10/2025) — food protection manager certification required, held by someone working in the facility; ServSafe accepted incl. online proctoring; exemptions reviewed by MSDH.
